en.description: Keep a record of your community's parking spots and share the free ones for a fee. Sign in, add your spots and see who rents them.

landing.headline: Every parking spot accounted for, and paid when shared
landing.subheadline: For neighbours and building communities: list your spots first, then share the free ones for a fee.
landing.featuresHeading: Keep spots and income in order

features.title: One register of spots

features.title: Spots on a map

features.title: Paid sharing
features.description: Set a monthly price for a free spot and mark it rented once it is taken.

features.description: Check how many spots are rented and what they bring in each month.

steps.description: Record each spot with its address, status and monthly price.

steps.title: Track what is rented
steps.description: Follow the status of every spot and the income from them on your dashboard.

items.question: Who is it for?
items.answer: For communities, neighbours and building residents who want to keep track of parking spots and share free ones for payment.

items.question: Do I need an account?
items.answer: Browsing the offers is open to everyone. To keep your own register of spots you sign in with Google.

items.question: Are the offers on the page real?
items.answer: No. They are illustrative examples until the owner replaces them with real spots.

items.question: How do I ask about a spot?
items.answer: Use the inquiry button on a card or the contact form and leave your e-mail.

sk.description: Evidujte parkovacie miesta vašej komunity a voľné z nich zdieľajte za poplatok. Prihláste sa, pridajte miesta a sledujte ich prenájom.

items.question: Pre koho je aplikácia?
items.answer: Pre komunity, susedov a obyvateľov bytových domov, ktorí chcú viesť evidenciu parkovacích miest a voľné zdieľať za platbu.

items.question: Potrebujem účet?
items.answer: Prezerať ponuky môže každý. Na vlastnú evidenciu miest sa prihlásite cez Google.

items.question: Sú ponuky na stránke skutočné?
items.answer: Nie. Ide o ilustračné príklady, kým ich majiteľ nenahradí skutočnými miestami.

items.question: Ako sa opýtam na miesto?
items.answer: Použite tlačidlo dopytu na karte alebo kontaktný formulár a zanechajte e-mail.
